question: What alternative ritual procedure involves a dhatura seed and smearing on a foot?
premises: A dhatura seed or ear-related implement is used.
Recitation and smearing are part of the procedure.
The application is made on that foot.
inference: Alternatively, after reciting and smearing with a dhatura seed implement, one applies it on that foot.
uncertainties: karṇena is ambiguous (ear/handle/part); tat+pade referent depends on prior context
plain_english: Or, having recited and smeared with a dhatura seed implement, one applies it on that foot.
